purpose: Focus the near-real-time monitor on reliability and uncertainty control when expert field/reference labels are not yet available.
accuracy_claim: No field accuracy claim; this is model-risk and weak-evidence guidance.

allowed: Use train/validation reports to plan future model improvements.
Keep 2026 metrics as a frozen benchmark for later comparison.
forbidden: Do not retrain from this result.
Do not tune thresholds, architecture, class weights, or pseudo-label filters from this result.
Do not claim field accuracy from weak-source agreement.

risk_drivers.evidence: Mean confidence is much lower on the frozen 2026 benchmark than on train/validation full-AOI records.
risk_drivers.safe_action: Add cleaner train/validation scenes and retrain later, then evaluate once on the untouched 2026 benchmark.

risk_drivers.evidence: Large 2026 areas have high normalized entropy.
risk_drivers.safe_action: Use entropy as a review-zone mask and avoid publishing low-certainty alerts as confident changes.

risk_drivers.evidence: Dynamic World, ESA WorldCover, and OSM do not support the same class everywhere in the 2026 AOI.
risk_drivers.safe_action: Require stronger weak-source agreement for high-confidence zones and keep disagreement zones visible for review.

risk_drivers.evidence: Model probability and weak-source support are not yet well aligned.
risk_drivers.safe_action: Report calibrated reliability bands separately from raw model probability.

risk_drivers.evidence: Water/moisture, bare/sparse, and mixed classes are much rarer than vegetation/built-up.
risk_drivers.safe_action: Keep class-balanced patch sampling and rare-class loss weighting in the next train/validation-only model iteration.

risk_drivers.evidence: Kigali AOI has steep terrain that can affect radar, shadow, moisture, and settlement signals.
risk_drivers.safe_action: Use DEM, slope, ruggedness, and TPI as model features and as review cues.

likely_changes_without_expert_samples.expected_direction: Raw confidence may increase or decrease, but reliability interpretation should improve.
likely_changes_without_expert_samples.why: Calibration separates model probability from weak-source support instead of treating probability as truth.

likely_changes_without_expert_samples.change: Lower review burden on future validation scenes
likely_changes_without_expert_samples.expected_direction: Review-zone fraction should decrease if train/validation-only retraining learns cleaner weak labels.
likely_changes_without_expert_samples.why: Strict pseudo-label filtering and temporal consensus remove noisy labels before retraining.

likely_changes_without_expert_samples.expected_direction: Single-date false alarms should decline when temporal persistence gates change publication.
likely_changes_without_expert_samples.why: Persistent changes across multiple Sentinel-1/2 dates are more reliable than one-date spikes.

likely_changes_without_expert_samples.change: Improved class separation in terrain-affected areas
likely_changes_without_expert_samples.expected_direction: Some bare/sparse, moisture, and built-up confusions should reduce.
likely_changes_without_expert_samples.why: Slope and topographic position explain shadows, drainage, radar geometry, and settlement patterns.

likely_changes_without_expert_samples.expected_direction: The system becomes more useful for screening, but not authoritative mapping.
likely_changes_without_expert_samples.why: Expert samples are still required for confusion matrix, user accuracy, producer accuracy, and F1.

recommended_next_controls: Publish reliability bands: supported, caution, review-required.
Gate change alerts using confidence, entropy, weak agreement, and temporal persistence.
Use only train/validation data for the next retraining cycle.
Reserve the frozen 2026 benchmark for a single later comparison after retraining.
Add a small expert sample later to convert reliability into true accuracy metrics.
